description: Vault extended info is write-once: once set, every PUT or PATCH (with or without an If-Match etag, even with identical properties) fails with HTTP 412 and an empty body, which surfaced as a retried UnknownAzureError. Add the optional If-Match header member from the spec and type the 412 as VaultExtendedInfoAlreadySet.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Etag of the current extended info (from a GET); "*" matches any version.
The service's error detail (empty for this error).
The vault's extended info is already set; Azure does not allow changing it (HTTP 412 with an empty body).
